About SHOGA

Confidence isn't a product.
But it can start with one.

We started SHOGA because every beauty brand was selling the same thing: fixes. Something to hide, cover, correct. We wanted to sell the opposite, the feeling of having nothing to hide.

So we made the simplest possible ritual. One sachet, one glass, every day. Not a transformation. A habit of choosing yourself, ten seconds at a time.

Questions

Before you begin

When will I notice a difference?

Everyone's skin is different, so we don't promise overnight miracles. Collagen rewards consistency. We recommend the daily ritual for at least 8–12 weeks.

What does it taste like?

Soft, ripe white peach. Lightly sweet with no added sugar, and it dissolves fully in cold water.

Can I take it with other supplements?

Usually, yes. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have a medical condition, check with your doctor first.

How does monthly delivery work?

A fresh box every 30 days at 15% off, with free shipping. Skip, pause or cancel anytime from your account.

How long does one box last?

30 sachets, one a day. One box is one month of the ritual.

Ready when you are.
